Remark
[$\varepsilon $-isometries control Gromov--Hausdorff distance]

Source: petersen:page-0453 ↗ def:pet-ch11-gromov-hausdorff-distance 1. ch11:11.6.2Suppose a (not necessarily continuous) map $F:X\to Y$ satisfies $\big||x_1x_2|-|F(x_1)F(x_2)|\big|\le \varepsilon $ for all $x_1,x_2\in X$ and $F(X)\subset Y$ is $\varepsilon $-dense, show $\dGH (X,Y)<2\varepsilon $.
